name: Contextual color appearance
observation: Albers digital edition describes identical colors appearing different on different grounds.
transfer: Review color in its actual surround; compare same token on all intended surfaces.
limit: No psychophysical test or original plate reproduction.

name: Structural chromatic economy
observation: MoMA collection and design history identify Swiss typographic rigor; Der Film is a concrete reference.
transfer: Use scale, grid and typography before adding decorative hues.
limit: No pixel sampling; economy is an analyst transfer, not a universal Swiss rule.

name: Spatial chromatic articulation
observation: Architectural polychromy uses color to articulate perceived planes and volumes.
transfer: Bind surface colors to spatial roles; keep quantitative encoding independent.
limit: Warm/cool depth effects are contextual, not geometric evidence.

name: Figure-ground exhibition
observation: Smithsonian guidance emphasizes visibility of objects, label contrast and navigable routes.
transfer: Give primary subject a quiet contrasting surround; inspect labels and glare.
limit: Physical exhibit lighting rules are not direct web compliance standards.

name: Operational signal exclusivity
observation: NASA handbook discusses functional label color consistency and viewing conditions.
transfer: Reserve operational signals and supplement them with labels and shapes.
limit: Do not import safety color meanings into unrelated domains without checking standards.

name: Chromatic narrative arc
observation: Cinematographer describes restrained watercolor palette and three-act color changes.
transfer: Use scene atmosphere changes at narrative boundaries while preserving data color identity.
limit: No frame-level color extraction; mood mapping is contextual.

name: Curated palette rehearsal
observation: Production tested lighting colors on camera and reduced options to a reusable set.
transfer: Preview a limited palette with actual marks, text and materials before committing.
limit: No reproduction of production colors or evaluation of exact footage.
